title: Listen and Choose a Response — Campus Library

questions.stem: What time does the library close on Fridays?

options.A: I'm not sure, but the hours are posted by the door.
options.B: I closed the window before I left the library.
options.C: Yes, I go there every Friday afternoon.
options.D: It's on the second floor, next to the café.

questions.explanation: The speaker asks for a closing time; admitting uncertainty and pointing to where the hours are posted is a natural indirect reply.
